name: thunderbird-omnisearch
description: Fast, fuzzy, relevance-ranked email search for Thunderbird, powered by MiniSearch.
author: CR0CKER
//: This extension ships plain JS with NO build/install step. Its one runtime dependency (MiniSearch) is VENDORED — committed at lib/minisearch.js, loaded via importScripts, never installed from npm. This manifest exists solely to pin the vendored version so GitHub's dependency graph, Dependabot alerts, and osv-scanner track MiniSearch CVEs. See lib/VENDOR.md before bumping.
